The next covered gainers by move were OLOX, up 66 percent from the prior close, with no catalyst found in our sources, and IPDN, up 40 percent from the prior close, with fresh news found in our sources: an equipment lease and loan financing for NVIDIA B300 GPU systems. 8 of the 12 names the desk covers had fresh news in our sources.

The next covered gainers by move were OLOX, up 66 percent from the prior close, with no catalyst found in our sources, and IPDN, up 40 percent from the prior close, with fresh news found in our sources: an equipment lease and loan financing for NVIDIA B300 GPU systems. 8 of the 12 names the desk covers had fresh news in our sources.

lines.text: The company announced at 08:30 ET on October 6, 2026 a proposed expansion of its U.S. AI business, a planned reduction of its mainland China operations, and an intended U.S. investment of $5 million to $10 million. The desk reads it as a proposed strategic shift with a stated investment range rather than a completed investment, contract or regulatory approval, and the primary newswire item carries no recorded publication timestamp in our sources.

Locafy announced on October 6, 2026 a definitive agreement to acquire Map Labs' assets and customer base for up to $3.0 million in cash, $2.0 million upfront and up to $1.0 million tied to performance, and stated the business is expected to add about $2.0 million of ARR and about $900,000 of 2026 EBIT, per a 6-K at 09:29 ET. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions, and our sources give no closing date and no certainty on whether the performance-based portion becomes payable.

Barnwell agreed on October 5, 2026 to sell its Canadian oil and natural gas business for a C$9 million base price, made up of C$4 million cash plus a 5% gross overriding royalty with a buyer option to purchase that royalty after closing for C$5 million, per an 8-K at 06:30 ET October 6, 2026. The sale is subject to closing conditions and working-capital and indebtedness adjustments, and our sources state no closing date or final net proceeds.

Since the previous checkpoint, SMXT printed a new high of day. This is not a fresh catalyst: the latest company-specific item in our sources is the August 21, 2026 Nasdaq noncompliance notice at 17:15 ET for the delayed June 30 Form 10-Q, after a one-for-12 reverse split, and the sources identify no buyer, news trigger or order-flow attribution for the session's demand.

Kairos reported positive, statistically significant interim efficacy data from its ongoing Phase 2 trial of ENV-105 with apalutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, per an 8-K at 07:30 ET October 6, 2026, with secondary coverage citing 17.7-month median progression-free survival versus 2 months. The primary excerpt in our sources gives no sample size, follow-up duration or full statistical results.

Robo.ai reported at 06:00 ET October 6, 2026 that September revenue exceeded US$100 million and said it expects approximately US$600 million of revenue for full-year 2026. Our sources include no audited financial statement supporting the September figure.

This is not a fresh catalyst: the latest item in our sources is an October 4, 2026 release at 17:33 ET from the company's first annual Las Vegas conference, in which AIFA said two Teach OS modules were live, four more were in development, and a formal launch was expected in the near term. The release gives no revenue, customer, contract-value or launch-date figures, and nothing in our sources quantifies the commercial impact of Teach OS.

Secondary reports at 09:01 ET October 6, 2026 said Vivakor entered a non-binding indication of interest to acquire 100% of the membership interests of Direct Midstream, with financial terms not disclosed. No primary company release or SEC filing is in our sources, and price, definitive-agreement status, closing conditions and timing were not reported.
No research is on file for AVBP at this checkpoint.

PDN Intelligence on October 5 entered an equipment lease for one NVIDIA B300 eight-GPU system at $588,581.99 and agreed to lend $588,849.23 to finance a second system, about $1.177 million of initial capital commitments, per an 8-K at 07:24 ET October 6, 2026. Our sources do not establish deployment, utilization, revenue or how the commitments are financed.

On October 6 the company said it intends to conclude enrollment at 30 subjects in its severe-babesiosis tafenoquine study, unblind it, report primary and secondary endpoint results in January 2027, and request a pre-sNDA meeting with the FDA that month, per an 8-K at 07:45 ET; no endpoint results were disclosed. Our sources contain no unblinded results and no FDA acceptance, decision or approval.

No catalyst found in our sources: the latest primary issuer item is a September 17, 2026 report at 09:00 ET of August Bitcoin production, and October 5 to 6 secondary coverage names OLOX as an after-hours mover without identifying a new issuer event. Our sources do not identify the source of the live demand.
